d: More than 30 passenger flights across Europe have been targeted by bomb threats. Planes have been diverted, passengers evacuated and fighter jets scrambled. The threats have continued for days, raising questions about who is behind them and what they want to achieve. Meanwhile, cyberattacks have hit supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe and blood-storage facilities in France. These incidents have brought the threat of hybrid warfare back into focus. But are they connected? And is Europe facing a wider campaign of disruption?
